response.final_text:
I propose closing this alert as a false positive (**CLOSE_FP**), with confidence **0.88**. The proposal is filed as case C-A-261020-0004 and is waiting for a human decision.

**The three facts that drove it:**
1. **This is two-sided market making.** T-MM-02 is a registered market maker on SYN.A. It kept one bid and one ask of 381 each in the book and re-quoted both together, so the cancels are balanced across sides (cancel symmetry 0.964, 12,192 submitted per side). The order-to-trade ratio of 16.0 matches its typical daily 15.9.
2. **No order was large.** The detector's "8,763–9,525 SELL" is the 381-lot sell quote re-submitted over and over, added up across 60 seconds. No single order was more than 0.143× the average top-5 depth of 2,665.
3. **There was no opposite-side benefit.** The "BUY executions" in the trigger were partial fills on the trader's own resting bids, 850 in total, all before any opposite-side trade. The trader had no sell fills at all, so there is no round trip and no price move it gained from.

**What would change my mind:** evidence over a longer time frame that the 850 net long bought here was later sold at a profit, after a price move the trader's own quotes caused. I only analysed the alert window plus 5 seconds either side.
